muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿هو الذي أخرج الذين كفروا من أهل الكتاب من ديارهم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or it is circumstantial (a ḥāl); هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذي is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿أخرج﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. الذين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿الذين﴾, with no grammatical position. من أهل الكتاب is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الذين كفروا, and من ديارهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخرج﴾.
﴿لأول الحشر﴾: this lām is attached to ﴿أخرج﴾, and it is the lām of timing (lām al-tawqīt).
﴿ما ظننتم أن يخرجوا﴾: ما is negative; ظننتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); أن is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; يخرجوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; and أن together with what falls in its scope stands in place of the two objects of ظننتم.
﴿وظنوا أنهم مانعتهم حصونهم من الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ظنوا is a past verb, one of the verbs of the heart (afʿāl al-qulūb), and the wāw is the fāʿil; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism); مانعتهم is the khabar of أنهم, and حصونهم is the fāʿil of مانعتهم; or مانعتهم is a fronted khabar and حصونهم a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the khabar of أنهم; من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مانعتهم﴾; and the clause ﴿أنهم مانعتهم ...﴾ stands in place of the two objects of ظنوا.
﴿فأتاهم الله من حيث لم يحتسبوا وقذف في قلوبهم الرعب﴾: the fāʾ is for conjunction with immediate sequence (taʿqīb); أتاهم الله is a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and a postponed fāʿil; من is a preposition, and حيث is an adverb of place, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by من, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أتاهم; لم is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; يحتسبوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; and the clause is in the position of a genitive through the adverb's being annexed to it; قذف is conjoined to فـ﴿أتاهم﴾; في قلوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قذف; and الرعب is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿يخربون بيوتهم بأيديهم وأيدي المؤمنين﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or it is a ḥāl from the pronoun in قلوبهم; يخربون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; بيوتهم is the mafʿūl bihi; بأيديهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخربون﴾; أيدي is conjoined to بأيديهم; and المؤمنين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فاعتبروا يا أولي الأبصار﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); اعتبروا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; يا is a vocative particle; أولي is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative by the yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; and الأبصار is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿ولولا أن كتب الله عليهم الجلاء لعذبهم في الدنيا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لولا is a particle of non-occurrence due to existence (ḥarf imtināʿ li-wujūd); أن is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما﴾ and what follows it is a mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "existing" (موجود) [Translator's note: the source writes ﴿ما﴾ here, but the maṣdar-forming particle in this phrase is أن]; كتب الله is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كتب﴾; الجلاء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām occurs in the apodosis of لولا; عذبهم is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and a mafʿūl bihi; في الدنيا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عذبهم﴾; and the clause ﴿ولولا أن كتب...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولهم في الآخرة عذاب النار﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لهم is a fronted khabar; في الآخرة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from عذاب; عذاب النار is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿ولهم في الآخرة...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿ذلك بأنهم شاقوا الله ورسوله﴾: ذلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and بأنهم is the khabar (predicate) of ذلك; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism), and the clause شاقوا is its khabar; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and رسوله is conjoined to the Word of Majesty.
﴿ومن يشاق الله فإن الله شديد العقاب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ; يشاق is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the Word of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "He will punish" (يعاقب); the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); إن is an abrogating particle, the Word of Majesty is its noun, and شديد is its khabar. You may also make the fāʾ the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa), and the clause is then in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis; and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿ما قطعتم من لينة أو تركتموها قائمة على أصولها فبإذن الله﴾: ما is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿قطعتم﴾; قطعتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); من لينة is a ḥāl (circumstantial); أو is a conjunction; تركتموها is conjoined to قطعتم; قائمة is the second object of ﴿ترك﴾; على أصولها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قائمة﴾; the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition; بإذن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "so cutting them is by Allah's permission" (فقطعها بإذن الله); and the nominal clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿وليخزي الفاسقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and what it is conjoined to is omitted, its implied form being "He permitted cutting them, to gladden the believers and strengthen them, and to disgrace the hypocrites and the transgressors and abase them"; the lām is the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl); يخزي is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted and supplied; and الفاسقين is the object of يخزي.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿وما أفاء الله على رسوله منهم فما أوجفتم عليه من خيل ولا ركاب﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ما is a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause أفاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. الله is the fāʿil (agent); على رسوله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أفاء﴾; منهم is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); ما is negative; أوجفتم is a verb and its fāʿil; عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أوجفتم﴾; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and خيل is genitive by من in form and accusative in position, as the object of أوجفتم; and لا ركاب is conjoined to خيل.
﴿ولكن الله يسلط رسله على من يشاء﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk) that governs the accusative; the Word of Majesty is its noun (ism), and the clause يسلط is its khabar (predicate); رسله is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يسلط; على من يشاء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسلط﴾; and the clause يشاء is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله على كل شيء قدير﴾: الله is the mubtadaʾ; على كل شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قدير﴾; and قدير is the khabar of the Word of Majesty الله.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿ما أفاء الله على رسوله من أهل القرى﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ما is a relative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause أفاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. الله is the fāʿil (agent); على رسوله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أفاء﴾; and من أهل القرى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أفاء﴾.
﴿فلله وللرسول ولذي القربى واليتامى والمساكين وابن السبيل﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), because of the sense of condition contained in the relative noun; لله is the khabar (predicate) of ما; and للرسول and what follows it are conjoined to His words لله.
﴿كي لا يكون دولة بين الأغنياء منكم﴾: كي is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle before which the lām is supplied; لا is negative; يكون is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by كي; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿كي لا يكون﴾ is genitive (majrūr) by an omitted lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar to which the preposition and genitive noun ﴿لله﴾ are attached, or they are attached to an omitted verb, the implied form being "Allah made the fayʾ thus, so that it would not be a circulation" (جعل الله الفيء كذلك لكي لا يكون دولة); the noun (ism) of يكون is latent (mustatir), referring back to the fayʾ; دولة is the khabar of يكون; بين is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of دولة; الأغنياء is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and منكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وما آتاكم الرسول فخذوه وما نهاكم عنه فانتهوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb indicated by خذوه. Or ﴿ما﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and the clause فخذوه is the khabar; the clause أتاكم is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The kāf is the mafʿūl bihi and الرسول is the fāʿil; the fāʾ is linking; and خذوه is an imperative verb, its fāʿil, and its mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وما نهاكم عنه فانتهوا﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿واتقوا الله إن الله شديد العقاب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا الله is an imperative verb, its fāʿil, and the Word of Majesty as object; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Word of Majesty is its noun, and شديد is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿للفقراء المهاجرين الذين أخرجوا من ديارهم وأموالهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a badal (substitute) from His words لذي القربى and what is conjoined to it; it has also been said: they are a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, its implied form being "marvel" (أعجبوا) [Translator's note: written thus in the source; the intended implied verb is presumably اعجبوا, "marvel (at)"]; المهاجرين is a naʿt (adjective) of الفقراء, and الذين is a second naʿt; the clause أُخرجوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; it is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); من ديارهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أخرجوا﴾; and أموالهم is conjoined to ديارهم.
﴿يبتغون فضلا من الله ورضوانا﴾: the clause is circumstantial (a ḥāl); فضلًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يبتغون﴾, or to an omitted naʿt of ﴿فضلًا﴾; and رضوانًا is conjoined to ﴿فضلًا﴾.
﴿وينصرون الله ورسوله﴾: the clause is conjoined to the clause يبتغون; the Word of Majesty is the object of ينصرون; and رسوله is conjoined to الله.
﴿أولئك هم الصادقون﴾: أولئك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a mubtadaʾ; الصادقون is the khabar (predicate) of أولئك, or the khabar of هم, and that clause is the khabar of أولئك.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿والذين تبوءوا الدار والإيمان من قبلهم يحبون من هاجر إليهم﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; you may also make it conjoined (mansūq) to الفقراء. So on these two views الذين is either a mubtadaʾ (subject), or conjoined to الفقراء and thus in the position of a genitive (majrūr). The clause تبوءوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; الدار is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الإيمان is the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "and they made sincere" (وأخلصوا), the conjunction then being a conjoining of clauses; it has also been said that it is on the omission of a muḍāf, or that it is accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿تبوءوا﴾ after this has been made to include the sense of "they held fast to" (لزموا); من قبلهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تبوءوا or to the supplied ألفوا ("they became familiar with") [Translator's note: the source here names the supplied verb as ألفوا, whereas above it gave it as وأخلصوا]; the clause يحبون is the khabar (predicate) of الذين; من is the mafʿūl bihi, and the clause هاجر is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. إليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿هاجر﴾.
﴿ولا يجدون في صدورهم حاجة مما أوتوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative; يجدون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); في صدورهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجدون﴾; حاجة is the mafʿūl bihi; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of حاجة; and the clause ﴿أوتوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويؤثرون على أنفسهم ولو كان بهم خصاصة﴾: conjoined to what precedes; على أنفسهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤثرون﴾; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لو is conditional; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of كان; and خصاصة is its postponed noun (ism).
﴿ومن يوق شح نفسه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is conditional, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; يوق is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; it is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); and شح is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فأولئك هم المفلحون﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition; أولئك is a mubtadaʾ; هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a second mubtadaʾ; المفلحون is the khabar of أولئك, or the khabar of هم, and that clause is the khabar of أولئك; the clause ﴿فأولئك﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of من; and the clause ﴿ومن يوق...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿والذين جاءوا من بعدهم يقولون ربنا اغفر لنا ولإخواننا الذين سبقونا بالإيمان﴾: الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿جاؤوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. من بعدهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءوا﴾; the clause يقولون is the khabar (predicate) of الذين; ربنا is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf; اغفر is a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); لإخواننا is conjoined to لنا; الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of إخواننا; the clause ﴿سبقونا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position. بالإيمان is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سبقونا﴾.
﴿ولا تجعل في قلوبنا غلا للذين آمنوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is of request (ṭalabiyya); تجعل is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾; في قلوبنا is in the place of the second object of تجعل, and غلًّا is its first object; and للذين is a naʿt of ﴿غلًّا﴾.
﴿ربنا إنك رءوف رحيم﴾: ربنا is the one addressed, a muḍāf; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun (ism); رؤوف is the first khabar of إن, and رحيم is its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿ألم تر إلى الذين نافقوا يقولون لإخوانهم الذين كفروا من أهل الكتاب﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); لم is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; تر is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); إلى الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تر﴾; the clause نافقوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿يقولون﴾ is resumptive, explaining what is being marvelled at, with no grammatical position; لإخوانهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقولون﴾; الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of إخوانهم; the clause كفروا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position. من أهل الكتاب is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿لئن أخرجتم لنخرجن معكم ولا نطيع فيكم أحدا أبدا﴾: the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of their speech; the lām is the lām that prepares for an oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is conditional; أخرجتم is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the lām [of لنخرجن] is likewise of the answer to the oath; نخرجن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath; the apodosis of the conditional إن is omitted; معكم is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to ﴿نخرجن﴾; the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative; نطيع is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), because it is conjoined to the clause ﴿لئن أخرجتم﴾; and so too His words: وإن قوتلتم; thus the object of their saying is three clauses. فيكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نطيع﴾ on the omission of a muḍāf; أحدًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and أبدًا is an adverb (ẓarf) of the negation, also attached to ﴿نطيع﴾.
﴿وإن قوتلتم لننصرنكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional, and before it the lām that prepares for an oath has been omitted; قوتلتم is a past verb in the passive, in the position of a jussive as the protasis; the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; ننصرنكم is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the apodosis of إن is omitted; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath.
﴿والله يشهد إنهم لكاذبون﴾: الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يشهد is the khabar (predicate); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), its hamza takes kasra because the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) occurs in its khabar; the hāʾ is its noun (ism), and كاذبون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿لئن أخرجوا لا يخرجون معهم﴾: the lām is the lām that prepares for an oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is conditional; أخرجوا is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named) [Translator's note: so in the source; أُخرجوا is in fact a past verb], and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); it is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis of إن is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath, which is the clause لا يخرجون; and معهم is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يخرجون﴾.
﴿ولئن قوتلوا لا ينصرونهم﴾: conjoined to what precedes; the lām prepares for an oath; إن is conditional; قوتلوا is an imperfect verb in the passive [Translator's note: so in the source; قوتلوا is in fact a past verb], and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; it is in the position of a jussive as the protasis; and the apodosis of إن is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath, which is the clause لا ينصرونهم.
﴿ولئن نصروهم ليولن الأدبار ثم لا ينصرون﴾: also conjoined. As for His words ليولن: the lām is of the answer to the oath; يولن is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, which has been dropped because of the succession of like letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil (agent); الأدبار is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ثم is a conjunction; لا is negative; and ينصرون is an imperfect verb conjoined to يولن, nominative like it. The pronouns refer back to the Jews, or to the hypocrites.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿لأنتم أشد رهبة في صدورهم من الله﴾: the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); أشد is the khabar (predicate); رهبة is a tamyīz (specification); في صدورهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun concealed in أشد; and من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رهبة﴾.
﴿ذلك بأنهم قوم لا يفقهون﴾: ذلك is the mubtadaʾ, and بأنهم is the khabar; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism), and قوم is its khabar; and the clause لا يفقهون is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قوم﴾.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿لا يقاتلونكم جميعا إلا في قرى محصنة أو من وراء جدر﴾: لا is negative; يقاتلونكم is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), with its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); جميعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); في قرى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يقاتلونكم﴾, and the pronoun refers to the Jews; محصنة is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قرى﴾; أو is a conjunction; من وراء is conjoined to ﴿في قرى﴾; and جدر is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿بأسهم بينهم شديد تحسبهم جميعًا وقلوبهم شتى﴾: the clause is resumptive, explaining their state, and has no grammatical position; بأسهم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); بينهم is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to ﴿شديد﴾; شديد is the khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿تحسبهم...﴾ is also resumptive, with no grammatical position; تحسبهم is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت), and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; جميعًا is the second mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); قلوبهم is a mubtadaʾ and شتى its khabar; and the clause is circumstantial (a ḥāl).
﴿ذلك بأنهم قوم لا يعقلون﴾: ذلك is the mubtadaʾ; بأنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism), and قوم is its khabar; and the clause لا يعقلون is a naʿt of ﴿قوم﴾.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿كمثل الذين من قبلهم قريبا ذاقوا وبال أمرهم﴾: in ﴿كمثل﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "their likeness is like the likeness of those…" (مَثَلُهم مِثْلُ مَثَل الذين); ﴿مثل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and الذين is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿من قبلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. قريبًا is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to the omitted notion of "being settled" (al-istiqrār) to which من قبلهم is attached; you may also attach it to ﴿ذاقوا﴾, and some attached it to a supplied muḍāf; ذاقوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and وبال أمرهم is the object.
﴿ولهم عذاب أليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لهم is a fronted khabar; عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ; عظيم is a naʿt (adjective) [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in this ayah is أليم, not عظيم]; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿كمثل الشيطان إذ قال للإنسان اكفر﴾: in ﴿كمثل﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "their likeness is like the likeness of Satan" (مَثَلُهم مِثْلُ مَثَل الشيطان); ﴿مَثَل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الشيطان; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) through the adverb's being annexed to it; للإنسان is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قال﴾; and the clause ﴿اكفر﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فلما كفر قال إني بريء منك﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, i.e. "and he disbelieved" (فكفر); لما is a temporal adverb meaning "when" (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or a linking particle (rābiṭa) that includes the sense of condition; the clause كفر is in the position of a genitive through the adverb's being annexed to it; the clause قال has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun (ism), and بريء is its khabar; and منك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بريء﴾.
﴿إني أخاف الله رب العالمين﴾: the clause is a false justification of his disowning him, for otherwise he does not fear Allah; إن is an abrogating particle, the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause أخاف الله is its khabar; and رب العالمين is a badal (substitute) from the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla), or a naʿt (adjective) of it.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿فكان عاقبتهما أنهما في النار خالدين فيها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; عاقبتهما is its fronted khabar (predicate); أن and what falls in its scope is its postponed noun (ism); في النار is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of أن; خالدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خالدين﴾.
﴿وذلك جزاء الظالمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ذلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject), the reference being to the punishment; جزاء الظالمين is the khabar of ذلك; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا اتقوا الله ولتنظر نفس ما قدمت لغد﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; اتقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the Word of Majesty is its object; the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; تنظر is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; نفس is the fāʿil; ما is the object of تنظر; and the clause قدمت is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. "it sent forward" (قدمته); and لغد is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قدمت﴾.
﴿واتقوا الله إن الله خبير بما تعملون﴾: the command to fear Allah is repeated to emphasise it; the clause إن الله خبير بما تعملون gives the reason for the command to fear Allah; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Word of Majesty is its noun (ism), and خبير is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿ولا تكونوا كالذين نسوا الله فأنساهم أنفسهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تكونوا is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, and the wāw is its noun (ism); in ﴿كالذين﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿تكون﴾; الذين is a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause نسوا الله is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. فأنساهم: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أنساهم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and أنفسهم is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أولئك هم الفاسقون﴾: أولئك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a second mubtadaʾ; الفاسقون is the khabar of أولئك, or the khabar of هم, and that clause is the khabar of أولئك.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿لا يستوي أصحاب النار وأصحاب الجنة﴾: لا is negative; يستوي is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); أصحاب النار is the fāʿil (agent); and أصحاب الجنة is conjoined to أصحاب النار.
﴿أصحاب الجنة هم الفائزون﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; أصحاب الجنة is the mubtadaʾ (subject); هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a second mubtadaʾ; and الفائزون is a khabar (predicate) in either case.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿لو أنزلنا هذا القرآن على جبل﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; لو is conditional; أنزلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); هذا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); القرآن is a badal (substitute); and على جبل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلنا﴾.
﴿لرأيته خاشعا متصدعا من خشية الله﴾: the lām links the apodosis of لو; رأيته is a verb, its fāʿil, and its mafʿūl bihi; خاشعًا is a second object, or a ḥāl (circumstantial), because the seeing may be either mental or visual; متصدِّعًا is a second ḥāl, or a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿خاشعًا﴾; and من خشية الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿متصدعًا﴾.
﴿وتلك الأمثال نضربها للناس﴾: the wāw is resumptive; تلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الأمثال is a badal; the clause نضربها is the khabar (predicate); للناس is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نضربها﴾; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿لعلهم يتفكرون﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) expressing hope (tarajjī); ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism); and the clause يتفكرون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿هو الله الذي﴾: هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الله is the first khabar (predicate); and الذي is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) from the position of لا together with its noun, because their position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (al-ibtidāʾ); or a badal from the pronoun concealed in the omitted khabar. The clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿عالم الغيب والشهادة﴾: عالم is a naʿt of the name of Allah, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma, or a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو; الغيب is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; الشهادة is conjoined by the wāw, genitive by the kasra; and the nominal clause ﴿هو الله﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.
﴿هو الرحمن الرحيم﴾: هو is a pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; الرحمن is a khabar, nominative by the ḍamma; الرحيم is a second khabar, nominative by the ḍamma; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive, reinforcing what came before.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿هو الله الذي﴾: هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الله is the first khabar (predicate); and الذي is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) from the position of لا together with its noun, because their position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (al-ibtidāʾ); or a badal from the pronoun concealed in the omitted khabar. The clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿الملك القدوس السلام المؤمن المهيمن العزيز الجبار المتكبر﴾: adjectives (nuʿūt) of the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla), or further khabars of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هو﴾, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive, reinforcing what came before.
﴿سبحان الله عما يشركون﴾: سبحان is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. standing in for the absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb; the Word of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); عما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سبحان﴾; and the clause يشركون is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿هو الله الخالق البارئ المصور﴾: هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the Most Beautiful Names that follow it are khabars (predicates).
﴿له الأسماء الحسنى﴾: له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; الأسماء is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and الحسنى is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿يسبح له ما في السماوات والأرض﴾: يسبح is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسبح﴾, or in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) ما; ما is a relative noun in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; في السماوات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. الأرض is conjoined by the wāw, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; and the clause is in the position of a nominative as a further khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هو﴾.
﴿وهو العزيز الحكيم﴾: هو is a pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; العزيز is a khabar, nominative by the ḍamma; الحكيم is a second khabar, nominative by the ḍamma; and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl, or in the position of a nominative by conjunction with the one before it.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿سبح لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض وهو العزيز الحكيم﴾: «سبح» is a past verb; «لله»: the lām is a preposition and the Word of Majesty is a genitive noun, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سبح»; and it has been said: the lām is redundant (ṣila). «ما» is the fāʿil (agent); «في السماوات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [word] which is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. «ما في الأرض» is conjoined to «ما في السماوات»; «هو» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), «العزيز» is a first khabar (predicate), and «الحكيم» is a second khabar.
